name: Goa
blurb: Sun-kissed beaches, Portuguese heritage churches, vibrant spice plantations, and exquisite coastal seafood.

name: Jaipur
blurb: The Pink City of Rajasthan featuring majestic hill forts, royal palaces, astronomical observatories, and vibrant bazaars.

name: Hyderabad
blurb: City of Pearls blending grand Nizami heritage, medieval fortress architecture, world-famous biryani, and modern tech vibrancy.
